magic_initiate_spell_lists.name: Cleric
magic_initiate_spell_lists.description: Choose two Cleric cantrips and one level 1 Cleric spell.

magic_initiate_spell_lists.name: Druid
magic_initiate_spell_lists.description: Choose two Druid cantrips and one level 1 Druid spell.

magic_initiate_spell_lists.name: Wizard
magic_initiate_spell_lists.description: Choose two Wizard cantrips and one level 1 Wizard spell.

magic_initiate_abilities.name: Wisdom

magic_initiate_abilities.name: Charisma
magic_initiate_abilities.description: Use Charisma as the spellcasting ability for these spells.

fighting_styles_2024.name: Archery
fighting_styles_2024.description: Gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

fighting_styles_2024.name: Defense
fighting_styles_2024.description: Gain +1 AC while wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor.

fighting_styles_2024.name: Great Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles_2024.description: Treat damage die results of 1 or 2 as 3 with a Two-Handed or Versatile Melee weapon held in both hands.

fighting_styles_2024.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles_2024.description: Add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage when using the Light property.

paladin_fighting_styles_2024.name: Archery

paladin_fighting_styles_2024.name: Defense

paladin_fighting_styles_2024.name: Great Weapon Fighting

paladin_fighting_styles_2024.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
paladin_fighting_styles_2024.description: Add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage when using the Light property.

paladin_fighting_styles_2024.name: Blessed Warrior
paladin_fighting_styles_2024.description: Learn two Cleric cantrips that count as Paladin spells for you.

ranger_fighting_styles_2024.name: Archery
ranger_fighting_styles_2024.description: Gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

ranger_fighting_styles_2024.name: Defense
ranger_fighting_styles_2024.description: Gain +1 AC while wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor.

ranger_fighting_styles_2024.name: Great Weapon Fighting
ranger_fighting_styles_2024.description: Treat damage die results of 1 or 2 as 3 with a Two-Handed or Versatile Melee weapon held in both hands.

ranger_fighting_styles_2024.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
ranger_fighting_styles_2024.description: Add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage when using the Light property.

ranger_fighting_styles_2024.name: Druidic Warrior
ranger_fighting_styles_2024.description: Learn two Druid cantrips that count as Ranger spells for you.

divine_orders.name: Protector
divine_orders.description: Gain Martial weapon proficiency and Heavy armor training.

divine_orders.name: Thaumaturge
divine_orders.description: Learn one extra Cleric cantrip and add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Arcana or Religion checks.

primal_orders.name: Magician
primal_orders.description: Learn one extra Druid cantrip and add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Arcana or Nature checks.

primal_orders.name: Warden
primal_orders.description: Gain Martial weapon proficiency and Medium armor training.

cleric_blessed_strikes.name: Divine Strike
cleric_blessed_strikes.description: Once per turn, add 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage to a weapon hit; 2d8 from Cleric level 14.

cleric_blessed_strikes.name: Potent Spellcasting
cleric_blessed_strikes.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to Cleric cantrip damage; from level 14, a damaging cantrip can also grant Temporary HP.

druid_elemental_fury.name: Potent Spellcasting
druid_elemental_fury.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to Druid cantrip damage; gain extended cantrip range at Druid level 15.

druid_elemental_fury.name: Primal Strike
druid_elemental_fury.description: Once per turn, add 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage to a weapon or Beast-form hit; 2d8 at level 15.

metamagic_2024.name: Careful Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point. Choose up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) creatures; they automatically succeed on the spell's save and take no damage if success would normally halve it.

metamagic_2024.name: Distant Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to double a spell's range of at least 5 feet, or make its Touch range 30 feet.

metamagic_2024.name: Empowered Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one); use the new rolls. Can combine with another Metamagic.

metamagic_2024.name: Extended Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to double duration up to 24 hours and gain Advantage on saves to maintain Concentration on the spell.

metamagic_2024.name: Heightened Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to give a target Disadvantage on saving throws against the spell.

metamagic_2024.name: Quickened Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to cast an action spell as a Bonus Action. You cannot use this after casting a level 1+ spell on the same turn or cast one afterward.

metamagic_2024.name: Seeking Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll a missed spell attack; use the new roll. Can combine with another Metamagic.

metamagic_2024.name: Subtle Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast without Verbal, Somatic, or unconsumed, cost-free Material components.

metamagic_2024.name: Transmuted Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to change Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder spell damage to another type from that list.

metamagic_2024.name: Twinned Spell
metamagic_2024.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to increase by one the effective level of a spell that can target another creature when upcast.

hunter_prey.name: Colossus Slayer
hunter_prey.description: Once per turn, a weapon hit against a creature missing HP deals +1d8 damage.

hunter_prey.name: Horde Breaker
hunter_prey.description: Once on your turn, attack a different nearby creature with your weapon.

hunter_defensive_tactics.name: Escape the Horde
hunter_defensive_tactics.description: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

hunter_defensive_tactics.name: Multiattack Defense
hunter_defensive_tactics.description: After a creature hits you, its other attack rolls against you this turn have Disadvantage.

elven_lineages.name: Drow
elven_lineages.description: Dancing Lights; Faerie Fire at level 3 and Darkness at level 5.

elven_lineages.name: High Elf
elven_lineages.description: Prestidigitation; Detect Magic at level 3 and Misty Step at level 5.

elven_lineages.name: Wood Elf
elven_lineages.description: Speed increase and Druidcraft; Longstrider at level 3 and Pass without Trace at level 5.

gnomish_lineages.name: Forest Gnome
gnomish_lineages.description: Minor Illusion and Speak with Animals.

giant_ancestries.name: Cloud's Jaunt
giant_ancestries.description: Teleport up to 30 feet as a Bonus Action.

giant_ancestries.name: Fire's Burn
giant_ancestries.description: Deal an extra 1d10 Fire damage on a hit.

giant_ancestries.name: Frost's Chill
giant_ancestries.description: Deal an extra 1d6 Cold damage and reduce Speed on a hit.

giant_ancestries.name: Hill's Tumble
giant_ancestries.description: Knock a Large or smaller target Prone on a hit.

giant_ancestries.name: Stone's Endurance
giant_ancestries.description: Reduce damage you take by 1d12 + Constitution modifier as a Reaction.

giant_ancestries.name: Storm's Thunder
giant_ancestries.description: Deal 1d8 Thunder damage to a creature that damages you.

tiefling_legacies.name: Abyssal
tiefling_legacies.description: Poison resistance, Poison Spray; Ray of Sickness at level 3 and Hold Person at level 5.

tiefling_legacies.name: Chthonic
tiefling_legacies.description: Necrotic resistance, Chill Touch; False Life at level 3 and Ray of Enfeeblement at level 5.

tiefling_legacies.name: Infernal
tiefling_legacies.description: Fire resistance, Fire Bolt; Hellish Rebuke at level 3 and Darkness at level 5.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Agonizing Blast
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage. You can add your Charisma modifier to that spell's damage rolls.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Armor of Shadows
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Ascendant Step
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Levitate on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Devil's Sight
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness both magical and nonmagical — within 120 feet of yourself.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Devouring Blade
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: The Extra Attack of your Thirsting Blade invocation confers two extra attacks rather than one.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Eldritch Mind
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to deal an extra 1d8 Force damage to the target, plus another 1d8 per level of the spell slot, and you can give the target the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Eldritch Spear
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage and has a range of 10+ feet. When you cast that spell, its range increases by a number of feet equal to 30 times your Warlock level.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Fiendish Vigor
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast False Life on yourself without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell with this feature, you don't roll the die for the Temporary Hit Points; you automatically get the highest number on the die.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Gaze of Two Minds
eldritch_invocations_2024.description:
You can use a Bonus Action to touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can take a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. The connection ends if you don't maintain it in this way.

While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you can cast spells as if you were in your space or the other creature's space if the two of you are within 60 feet of each other.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Gift of the Depths
eldritch_invocations_2024.description:
You can breathe underwater, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

You can also cast Water Breathing once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way again when you finish a Long Rest.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Gift of the Protectors
eldritch_invocations_2024.description:
A new page appears in your Book of Shadows when you conjure it. With your permission, a creature can take an action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one name).

When any creature whose name is on the page is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, the creature magically drops to 1 Hit Point instead. Once this magic is triggered, no creature can benefit from it until you finish a Long Rest.

As a Magic action, you can erase a name on the page by touching it.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Investment of the Chain Master
eldritch_invocations_2024.description:
When you cast Find Familiar, you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits.

Aerial or Aquatic. The familiar gains either a Fly Speed or a Swim Speed (your choice) of 40 feet.

Quick Attack. As a Bonus Action, you can command the familiar to take the Attack action.

Necrotic or Radiant Damage. Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.

Your Save DC. If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.

Resistance. When the familiar takes damage, you can take a Reaction to grant it Resistance against that damage.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Lessons of the First Ones
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You have received knowledge from an elder entity of the multiverse, allowing you to gain one Origin feat of your choice (see "Feats").

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Lifedrinker
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage (your choice) to the creature, and you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice to roll it and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point).

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Mask of Many Faces
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Disguise Self without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Master of Myriad Forms
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Alter Self without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Misty Visions
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Silent Image without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: One with Shadows
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: While you're in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Otherworldly Leap
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Jump on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Pact of the Blade
eldritch_invocations_2024.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can conjure a pact weapon in your hand — a Simple or Martial Melee weapon of your choice with which you bond — or create a bond with a magic weapon you touch; you can't bond with a magic weapon if someone else is attuned to it or another Warlock is bonded with it. Until the bond ends, you have proficiency with the weapon, and you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.

Whenever you attack with the bonded weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity; and you can cause the weapon to deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage or its normal damage type.

Your bond with the weapon ends if you use this feature's Bonus Action again, if the weapon is more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute or more, or if you die. A conjured weapon disappears when the bond ends.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Pact of the Chain
eldritch_invocations_2024.description:
You learn the Find Familiar spell and can cast it as a Magic action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Skeleton, Sphinx of Wonder, Sprite, or Venomous Snake (see "Monsters" for the familiar's stat block).

Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its Reaction.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Pact of the Tome
eldritch_invocations_2024.description:
Stitching together strands of shadow, you conjure forth a book in your hand at the end of a Short or Long Rest. This Book of Shadows (you determine its appearance) contains eldritch magic that only you can access, granting you the benefits below. The book disappears if you conjure another book with this feature or if you die.

Cantrips and Rituals. When the book appears, choose three cantrips, and choose two level 1 spells that have the Ritual tag. The spells can be from any class's spell list, and they must be spells you don't already have prepared. While the book is on your person, you have the chosen spells prepared, and they function as Warlock spells for you.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use the book as a Spellcasting Focus.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Repelling Blast
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that requires an attack roll. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with that cantrip, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Thirsting Blade
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only. With that feature, you can attack twice with the weapon instead of once when you take the Attack action on your turn.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Visions of Distant Realms
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Arcane Eye without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Whispers of the Grave
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations_2024.name: Witch Sight
eldritch_invocations_2024.description: You have Truesight with a range of 30 feet.
